original.description: Existing PF02 #9 and PF07 #5 native connector geometry; unchanged at zero fit adjustment

skadis.status: Modeled from reference dimensions; not print tested
skadis.author: John Mylchreest
changes: Ported connector solids to the browser manifold kernel; board-facing Y axis reversed
Independent backplate roots and staggered slot allocation inside shelf width
Tab raised from the rectangular-slot reference to clear the R2.5 slot ends at its selected width
Insertion lift derived from actual tail envelope rather than fixed 10 mm
Positive-volume tail/tab overlap for reliable solid union
Two-slot coupon shares the same connector construction as the shelf
skadis.check_scope: Digital solids, board collision, export and browser checks; no physical print or board fit test.

us_small.status: Modeled from reference dimensions; not print tested
changes: Ported L-pin hull and flat-sided locating pin to browser manifold geometry
Separate upper-hook and lower-pin clearances; actual hole size and panel thickness are independent
Preserved 5.4 mm backplate root material and 42 mm Gridfinity pitch
Positive-volume overlap between lower pin and tapered nose
No snap barb in this version
us_small.check_scope: Static panel clearance, fixed board pitch, closed connected exports and browser operation; installation motion and physical fit are not tested.
